subtasks.description: Create component value validation utility module with validation functions for resistance (1mΩ to 1GΩ), capacitance (1pF to 10,000µF), and inductance (1nH to 10H) ranges
Add validation checks for zero and negative values which are errors for R, L, C components
Integrate validation into component creation/input handlers to validate values when components are added to the circuit
Add warning system for unusual but valid values (outside typical ranges but within possible ranges)
